content:
If you have closed that Gmail account, and it's still set up in Thunderbird, you should copy all messages that you want to keep to Local Folders, then delete the account from Thunderbird. When you're asked to delete all data, including stored passwords, you can say 'yes' because you've already backed it up.

Also, remove any Gmail remote Calendars and Address Books you may be subscribed to that are associated with that account.
